question: How many teams win the Best Open-Source AI Project challenge, and what do they get?
answer_text: One team wins the Best Open-Source AI Project challenge. Each member of the winning team receives a DEV Badge on their DEV account, and the team may also receive MLH+DEV-branded swag bags, depending on availability and event arrangements. There is no universally guaranteed cash prize for this challenge.

passages.text: Build an original project that uses open-source or open-weight AI as an important part of how it works. Teams could create an agent skill, build with an open-weight large or small language model, or build or adapt an open-source model harness. These are examples within one challenge, and teams may combine them.
